title: Designer gráfico
description:
Vaga: Designer Gráfico Júnior

A Duloren é uma das marcas de lingerie mais emblemáticas e respeitadas do Brasil. Com uma história sólida e uma comunicação reconhecida por sua ousadia, inteligência e posicionamento feminino, a marca une tradição e inovação para seguir relevante e provocativa no cenário atual.

Mais do que criar peças gráficas, buscamos um(a) Designer Gráfico Júnior que respire cultura digital, seja heavy user de redes sociais, antenado(a) em tendências visuais, formatos e linguagens, e que tenha vontade real de aprender, evoluir e construir junto. Essa pessoa será parte ativa da construção estética da marca em todos os seus pontos de contato.

Atividades e Responsabilidades:

O(a) Designer Gráfico Júnior atuará no desenvolvimento, desdobramento e execução visual da comunicação da Duloren, com foco em canais digitais e campanhas. Suas principais responsabilidades incluem:

● Criação e Desdobramento Visual


• Desenvolver peças gráficas para redes sociais, e-commerce, campanhas promocionais e institucionais, garantindo alinhamento total com o brandbook da marca.


• Criar desdobramentos visuais de campanhas sazonais, lançamentos de coleção e ações promocionais.


• Adaptar layouts para diferentes formatos e plataformas (feed, stories, reels, banners, e-mail marketing, etc.).

● Redes Sociais e Cultura Digital


• Acompanhar tendências visuais, estéticas, formatos e movimentos das redes sociais, propondo soluções criativas e atuais.


• Colaborar com o time de conteúdo na construção de narrativas visuais alinhadas ao tom de voz da marca.


• Pensar design orientado a performance, considerando engajamento, legibilidade e impacto visual.

● Operacional e Rotina Criativa


• Atuar de forma ágil na produção de peças do dia a dia, respeitando prazos curtos e demandas simultâneas.


• Realizar ajustes, versões e otimizações constantes das peças, com atenção a detalhes técnicos e estéticos.


• Apoiar a organização de arquivos, versões e fluxos de aprovação.

● Campanhas e Produção


• Apoiar o desdobramento visual de shootings, campanhas e lançamentos, trabalhando a partir de key visuals definidos.


• Auxiliar na criação de apresentações visuais para projetos, campanhas e relatórios internos.

Habilidades Técnicas e Essenciais:

● Domínio básico a intermediário de ferramentas como Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator e InDesign.

● Compreensão de layouts para ambiente digital, hierarquia visual, tipografia e composição.

● Entendimento prático de formatos, proporções e boas práticas para Instagram, TikTok e outras plataformas.

● Capacidade de seguir brandbook, guias visuais e padrões de identidade.

● Habilidade para desenvolver apresentações visuais claras e bem estruturadas (PowerPoint / Google Slides).

Habilidades Comportamentais:

● Perfil curioso, com vontade de aprender, testar, ouvir feedbacks e evoluir constantemente.

● Interesse genuíno por tendências visuais, comportamento digital, moda e cultura pop.

● Capacidade de lidar com demandas urgentes, ajustes rápidos e múltiplos prazos.

● Abertura para mudanças de rota, ajustes de briefing e aprendizado contínuo no processo.

● Boa comunicação e colaboração com times de Conteúdo, Marketing, E-commerce e Coordenadoria.

Formação:

● Formação superior completa ou cursando a partir do penúltimo ano em Design Gráfico, Design Visual, Design de Moda, Comunicação Visual ou áreas correlatas.

Diferenciais

● Experiência prévia, mesmo que em estágio, com moda, varejo, e-commerce ou marcas digitais.

● Noções básicas de edição de vídeo e motion simples (After Effects, Premiere, CapCut ou similares).

● Conhecimento de tendências visuais aplicadas a social media.

● Familiaridade com ferramentas como Figma ou Canva.

Horário e Local

● Segunda a sexta-feira, das 8h às 17h

● Local: São Cristóvão

title: senai cetiqt
description:
QUEM SOMOS?
A indústria brasileira cria mais do que produtos, ela cria oportunidades e transforma vidas
No SENAI CETIQT nós trabalhamos para transformar vidas desenvolvendo oportunidades e soluções para uma indústria têxtil, química e de confecção mais inovadora, tecnológica e sustentável.
Antes de te apresentar quem somos é muito importante que você conheça o significado do nosso nome:
SENAI significa Serviço Nacional de Aprendizagem Industrial e CETIQT é um Centro de Tecnologia da Indústria Química e Têxtil.
Só pelo significado dos nomes você já consegue entender a relevância e papel estratégico que a nossa instituição desempenha ao apoiar o sistema S (SENAI, SESI, IEL) e capacitar profissionais para as demandas da indústria brasileira.
Porém, nós vamos muito além da capacitação de profissionais por meio de graduações, pós-graduações e cursos de curta duração.
Nós também desenvolvemos tecnologias, oferecemos consultorias em diversas áreas para empresas, microempreendedores e para a Defesa Estratégica do país, como as forças armadas, realizamos testes metrológicos acreditados pelo INMETRO, promovemos estudos de futuro, e personalizamos o ensino técnico para a necessidade das indústrias têxteis, de confecção e química.
Agora vamos entender um pouco mais sobre quem é o SENAI CETIQT?
O SENAI CETIQT é um centro de excelência reconhecido nacionalmente pela sua capacidade de gerar conhecimento e inovação para as cadeias produtivas dos setores químico, têxtil e de confecção.
Com mais de 75 anos de história, a instituição desempenha um papel fundamental no fortalecimento do futuro da indústria química e da moda, formando profissionais altamente capacitados, oferecendo consultorias especializadas e customizadas, e impulsionando o desenvolvimento de novos produtos, processos e projetos de pesquisa.
Alinhado às necessidades da indústria brasileira e às principais tendências globais, o SENAI CETIQT se dedica a promover a inovação, a sustentabilidade e a competitividade da indústria nacional, consolidando-se como um pilar essencial para o crescimento e a transformação do setor.
Responsabilidades e atribuições
1 - Apoio às atividades do setor de consultoria em confecção;
2 - Apoio nos processos e projetos do setor;
3 - Acompanhar a planilha de gestão de projetos e contratos do setor;
4 - Suporte à gestão da área e agenda dos consultores;
5 - Preencher planilhas e dar apoio na geração de relatórios das atividades desenvolvidas;
6 - Todas as atividades serão realizadas sob supervisão.
Requisitos e qualificações
É necessário ter concluído 50% da graduação em Administração e estar entre o 5º período ao 6º período.

Nossas equipes de logística estão mudando a maneira como interagimos com clientes em todo o mundo todos os dias e resolvendo alguns dos maiores desafios logísticos enfrentados não apenas pela Amazon, mas também por toda a indústria.
Sejam itens grandes ou pequenos, encontramos soluções para garantir que estamos cumprindo nossa promessa para os clientes. A equipe da Amazon Logistics Brasil (AMZL) está procurando por um/uma Analista de Operações Logísticas para se juntar ao time de gestão e monitoramento de coletas de sellers.
O/A Analista de Transporte - First Mile atua em uma escala 5x2 em revezamento de turnos. É responsável por monitorar o desempenho e a conformidade dos transportadores da operação de coleta (inbound), em coordenação com times internos e externos. Também é responsável por apoiar os lançamentos de novos parceiros logísticos de coleta. O trabalho exige alguém que tenha grande disposição para assumir responsabilidades, tenha habilidades para identificar padrões e tendências, juntamente com a capacidade de examinar detalhes e analisar dados, aprofundando-se nas causas raízes dos problemas operacionais e propondo soluções. As operações serão feitas 7 dias por semana, incluindo feriados; portanto, trabalhar em diferentes turnos será parte dessa função.
Local de trabalho: Rio de Janeiro/RJ
Tipo de atuação: Presencial
Escala: 5x2
Key job responsibilities
- Gerir a operação de coleta e entrega de pacotes de Marketplace na Amazon Logística;
- Monitorar diariamente, hora-hora a operação de coleta dos parceiros logísticos de coleta, resolvendo problemas operacionais para garantia das coletas no prazo;
- Gerir problemas diários junto os transportadores de forma colaborativa e construtiva, identificar oportunidades de melhoria no processo de ponta a ponta e identificar melhorias na área;
- Analisar dados de várias fontes e identificar tendências relevantes para que, a partir deles, decisões rápidas e importantes ao negócio sejam tomadas no dia-a-dia operacional.
- Gerir, analisar e melhorar as métricas de performance;
- Mergulhar profundamente nas causas raízes dos problemas operacionais;
- Responder os tickets abertos pelos vendedores parceiros em relação a temas da coleta;
- Apresentar métricas para clientes internos e externos – comunicação frequente com os mesmos em busca de soluções operacionais de coleta;
- Servir de elo de ligação entre os stakeholders internos e externos tendo em vista os objetivos, limites, conformidade e privacidade das informações;
- Encontrar soluções práticas e simples para problemas complexos no dia-a-dia;
Basic Qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent in business, operations, logistics, supply chain or engineering
- Habilidade para multitarefas, gerenciando vários parceiros de coleta simultaneamente com atenção aos detalhes de sua estação;
- Disponibilidade para trabalhar em turnos flexíveis incluindo fins de semana e feriados;
- MS Office, com nível intermediário em Excel (vlookup, fórmulas avançadas, tabelas dinâmicas, macros);
- Português fluente;
- Experiência em Logística, Transporte;
- Disponibilidade para trabalho 100% presencial;
Preferred Qualifications:
- Inglês intermediário;
- Excelentes habilidades de Comunicação - lidar com transportadoras como stakeholders/clientes;
- Conhecimentos de Last Mile e eCommerce;
- Experiência anterior no acompanhamento de processos e análises, métricas e resolução de problemas;
- A pessoa deve estar disposta a trabalhar de forma independente;

title: Quality Control Inspector
description:
Job Title: QC Inspector WAG Manifolds
Location: Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
Employment Type: 12-months renewable
About the Company
Our client is a major international energy company with a strong global presence and a long track record of delivering complex offshore developments. Operating across deepwater and shallow-water environments, the organization is currently advancing one of the most significant new exploration and production projects, involving state-of-the-art floating production facilities and extensive subsea infrastructure.
The project is being developed by a multidisciplinary international team with a strong focus on safety, technical excellence, environmental performance, and schedule optimization.
With large-scale fabrication campaigns underway and multiple international work sites involved, the client offers exposure to technically challenging projects, modern project execution methodologies, and collaboration with experienced professionals from across the global energy sector.
About the Role
The Service Provider will be providing QC services at WAG (Water Alternate Gas) manifolds worksite based in Rio, Brazil with frequent travel within to Distrito Industrial – Vespasiano/MG Brasil. You will be responsible to ensure that Contractor (CTR) supplies WAG Manifold and Foundations on-time as per the clients HSE policies and with satisfactory & required level of quality.
The Service Provider will liaise with CPY Subsea HSE Lead, CPY Quality Lead, CPY Materials & Welding Lead and CPY Delivery Lead.
HSE and Compliance: The Service holder shall:
Fully comply with site security, health and safety instructions, stay vigilant and maintain continuous awareness of hazards and surroundings.
Will be accountable for demonstrating, individually, an exemplary behaviour regarding HSE rules & requirements, including trainings, and enforcing HSE execution decisions/directions taken by CPY Subsea HSE Lead.
Report any issue/anomalies (using system in place in the facility) and to make use of TOTAL STOP WORK policy as necessary.
Ensure that risk assessments are performed as and when necessary, that management of change is adhered to and that tool-box talks are conducted efficiently.
Adopt and demonstrate exemplary behaviour regarding Company Ethics and "Code of Conduct" policy and promote the re-enforcement of the Anti-Corruption Program.
WORK TASKS: The Service holder will be responsible to control that the work performed by CTR and sub-CTR is in line with CPY and Project Specifications for WAG Manifolds and Foundations in terms of Quality.
For all these tasks, the incumbent will be requested:
To conduct thorough inspections of welds and welding processes to ensure compliance with applicable WPS/PQR, codes, standards, and specifications, have ability to conduct welding inspection before, during and after as per ISO requirements
To have ability to conduct welding inspection before, during and after as per ISO requirements
To have extensive inspection knowledge and experience (min 10 years) in CRA materials such as Super duplex (Pipe/Forging and HIPPED), Inconel 625 and LAS (F22)
To have excellent inspection experience in buttering, overlay and girth welding of Inconel 625 and Alloy 59 consumables
To utilize advanced inspection techniques including visual, ultrasonic, Phase Array Ultrasonic Testing (PAUT), magnetic particle, Liquid penetrant Inspection and radiographic testing to assess weld quality as per ASME/DNV code requirements
To have ability to interpret welding procedure specifications (WPS) and procedure qualification records (PQR) to validate conformance at site during production
To have the ability to perform inspection on incoming production materials against requirements and mill certificates
To participate in root cause analysis for welding defects and development of corrective action plans in collaboration with project welding engineer and site production teams
To identify and raise subsequent comments highlight deviations, unacceptable or unjustified quality issues related but not limited to Welding that could affect SPS equipment during fabrication, installation, and production at site
To prepare detailed inspection reports and documentation for compliance on weekly basis
To collaborate with Company Site Rep and CPY material engineer on any welding/NDT/material issues at site
To stop the work in case of non-conformity and re-assess the situation before resuming To discuss with contractor/sub-contractors in case of issues/unconformity during the control program, to look for acceptable solutions in order not to penalize the delivery schedule but still fulfilling the quality standards set by the contract
To ensure that unconformities are driven towards closure in a timely manner (i.e. without impacting the delivery schedule)
To follow up site welding activities and provide feedback to project team
To participate to COMPANY and contractor audits and follow up closure of identified issues
About You
You are a highly experienced welding and quality professional with a strong background in subsea structures and WAG manifolds. You bring more than 15 years of hands-on experience in welding inspection, with deep technical knowledge of welding processes, materials, and offshore fabrication requirements.
You hold a recognized Welding Inspector certification such as CSWIP 3.1 or 3.2 (or equivalent) and are certified to Level 3 in multiple Non-Destructive Testing methods, including Ultrasonic Testing (UT/PAUT), Radiography (RT), and Dye Penetrant Inspection (DPI).
You are confident in interpreting complex engineering drawings, technical specifications, and welding documentation, and you are known for your strong analytical skills and ability to investigate root causes and resolve challenging quality issues in fast-paced project environments.
You communicate clearly and professionally in English, with additional language skills in Portuguese or French considered an advantage.
What's on Offer?
Working for a leading operator.
12-month renewable contract.

description:
This position requires full relocation to Saudi Arabia. It is a permanent full time Expat Relocation Package.
Job Overview
We are seeking an Analyzer Engineer to join our Technical Support team under Global Manufacturing Organization.
The Technical Support Team is a multi-disciplinary team focusing mainly on supporting the technical and business needs of GM Operating facilities.
Your primary role is to handle analyzer engineering aspects. This will include designing, developing, installing, managing, and maintaining analyzer systems, across multiple facilities from the Downstream. You will also be responsible for providing technical support on high priority systems issues.
Key Responsibilities
As the successful candidate you will be required to perform the following:
Provide technical guidance, support, training, and expertise to plant departments.
Monitor Analyzer systems performance across all downstream departments.
Assess Analyzer systems performance and recommend improvements for system optimization.
Develop and maintain lifecycle management activities for Analyzer systems.
Establish auditing guidelines and perform frequent Analyzer audits.
Lead the development of new strategies and validate the feasibility of improving company productivity.
Ensure manufacturing knowledge is captured in the knowledge repository and continuous improvement is delivered by benchmarking and best practices.
Provide awareness sessions and lead technical exchanges and conferences.
Maintain Analyzer systems knowledge repository.
Act as a subject matter expert in Analyzers and contribute to the troubleshooting activities.
Minimum Requirements
You will hold a Bachelor degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering or equivalent.
You will have a minimum of 12 years' experience in refining /oil and gas plants /petrochemical industries.
You will be proficient in the codes and standards in the oil and gas industry, i.e., API, BS, ISO, ASME, ANSI, IEC, ISA, IEEE, etc.
You will have strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
You will be familiarity with Analyzer types and applications.
You will have knowledge of oil/gas-related plant processes
You will be aware of Industry standards, country-specific regulations, and local codes
You will have excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
Working Environment
Our high-performing employees are drawn by the challenging and rewarding professional, technical and industrial opportunities we offer, and are remunerated accordingly.
At Aramco, our people work on truly world-scale projects, supported by investment in capital and technology that is second to none. And because, as a global energy company, we are faced with addressing some of the world's biggest technical, logistical and environmental challenges, we invest heavily in talent development.
We have a proud history of educating and training our workforce over many decades. Employees at all levels are encouraged to improve their sector-specific knowledge and competencies through our workforce development programs – one of the largest in the world.
Aramco energizes the world economy.
Aramco occupies a special position in the global energy industry. We are one of the world's largest producers of hydrocarbon energy and chemicals, with among the lowest Upstream carbon intensities of any major producer.
With our significant investment in technology and infrastructure, we strive to maximize the value of the energy we produce for the world along with a commitment to enhance Aramco's value to society.
Headquartered in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and with offices around the world, we combine market discipline with a generations' spanning view of the future, born of our nine decades experience as responsible stewards of the Kingdom's vast hydrocarbon resources. This responsibility has driven us to deliver significant societal and economic benefits to not just the Kingdom, but also to a vast number of communities, economies, and countries that rely on the vital and reliable energy that we supply.

Descrição da vaga

Na Inbrands, nosso universo é feito de marcas icônicas e pessoas protagonistas que acreditam na colaboração para impulsionar resultados. Estamos em busca de um(a)
Vendedor(a) de Loja
, profissional comunicativo(a), engajado(a) e apaixonado(a) por moda, capaz de oferecer uma experiência de compra única, construir relacionamentos com os clientes e contribuir para o alcance das metas de vendas com excelência.

Somos líderes e agimos como donos. Temos um imenso orgulho de tudo o que fazemos e um enorme prazer em cada realização. Executamos de forma simples, onde sempre prevalece o melhor argumento e a melhor ideia na gestão de moda.

Em nosso portfólio estão Bobstore, Ellus, Richards, Salinas, VR Collezioni e Tommy Hilfiger. Nossas marcas são consideradas icônicas e estão posicionadas como marcas premium com distribuição através de lojas próprias, franquias, multimarcas e e-commerce.

Se você gosta de moda, de um ambiente descontraído, dinâmico e cheio de desafios vem para Inbrands

Lembramos que nossas oportunidades são para todos. Na Inbrands, você encontra um ambiente diverso, com respeito e empatia.
Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Realizar o atendimento personalizado ao cliente, de acordo com suas preferências e necessidades;
  • Ser criativo e dinâmico para o alcance das metas de vendas;
  • Relacionar-se com os clientes na venda e no pós-venda;
  • Executar as tarefas operacionais da loja, como: gestão e organização de estoque, operação do sistema, devoluções e trocas.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Experiência no varejo de moda, será considerado um diferencial;
  • Excelente capacidade de comunicação verbal e escrita;
  • Habilidade de negociação e persuasão;
  • Orientação para o cliente e foco em resultados;
  • Proatividade e dinamismo;

Total Pass para você que gosta de cuidar da sua saúde, nada melhor que parceria com as melhores academias.

Nossa História

Quem Somos
Somos movimento, criatividade e história. A Inbrands nasceu em 2008 com um propósito claro: construir um ecossistema de marcas que inspiram pessoas e transformam a moda em experiência.

Reunimos em nosso portfólio nomes que atravessam gerações e estilos como Ellus, Richards, VR, Salinas e Tommy Hilfiger – marcas que vestem personalidade, atitude e autenticidade.

Não seguimos tendências. Criamos caminhos. Evoluímos com consistência, estratégia e muito trabalho. Somos apaixonados por construir marcas fortes e negócios sustentáveis, sempre com foco no desenvolvimento das pessoas que fazem tudo acontecer.

Nosso DNA
Acreditamos que a moda vai além do vestir — ela conecta histórias, expressa identidades e cria relações verdadeiras.

Nosso propósito é inspirar pessoas através da moda e da experiência de marca, com integridade, atitude e paixão por fazer acontecer. Crescemos valorizando aquilo que nunca sai de moda: gente, essência e verdade.

Na DPSP, lojas, CDs e corporativo, nosso trabalho vai além de processos: impacta a saúde e o bem-estar de milhões de brasileiros todos os dias. title: Supervisor de Expedição e Transportes (476011)
description:
Como é o ambiente de trabalho?
Ambiente de trabalho colaborativo, focado em fluidez e eficiência nas atividades. Gestão aberta à implementação constante de melhorias, criação ou alteração de processos, valorizando a comunicação clara entre equipes e setores. O espaço é dinâmico e orientado para resultados, com incentivo à autonomia e tomada de decisão responsável.
Priorizamos a segurança, organização e cumprimento de prazos, garantindo que cada etapa da operação logística seja realizada com qualidade e precisão. O supervisor encontrará um ambiente que estimula o desenvolvimento profissional, a liderança participativa e o engajamento dos colaboradores, sempre com foco na satisfação dos clientes e na construção de relacionamentos sólidos com fornecedores.
Responsabilidades da Oportunidade
O Supervisor de Expedição e Transportes é o líder estratégico e operacional responsável por garantir a eficiência, segurança e pontualidade de todo o fluxo logístico, o carregamento dos materiais até a entrega final ao cliente e logística reversa. O profissional deverá gerenciar equipes, frotas (própria e terceirizada) e processos, visando a otimização de custos e a excelência no nível de serviço.
Gestão de Pessoas e Liderança
Liderar e desenvolver a equipe operacional de motoristas e ajudantes de entrega, promovendo um ambiente de trabalho seguro, produtivo e de alta performance.
Realizar a gestão de desempenho, feedback e treinamento contínuo da equipe.
Garantir o cumprimento das normas de segurança do trabalho e de trânsito pela equipe.
Gestão de Frota e Manutenção
Gerenciar a manutenção da frota própria (preventiva, preditiva e corretiva), assegurando a disponibilidade e a confiabilidade dos veículos.
Controlar os custos de manutenção, consumo de combustível, pneus e demais insumos da frota.
Garantir a documentação e a regularização de todos os veículos da frota, conforme a legislação vigente.
Planejamento e Operação de Transportes
Negociar e gerenciar a frota terceirizada, incluindo a contratação de transportadoras e autônomos, garantindo o melhor custo-benefício e o cumprimento dos prazos de entrega.
Supervisionar a roteirização e o acompanhamento de rota da equipe, utilizando sistemas de gestão de transporte (TMS) para otimizar o tempo e reduzir a quilometragem percorrida.
Monitorar o desempenho das entregas em tempo real, tomando ações corretivas imediatas em caso de desvios ou imprevistos.
Gestão da Expedição e Carga
Acompanhar e fiscalizar o carregamento dos veículos, assegurando que a cubagem e o peso estejam adequados, e que os materiais (muitas vezes volumosos e pesados) sejam acondicionados de forma segura para evitar avarias no transporte.
Indicadores e Melhoria Contínua
Definir, monitorar e analisar os principais KPIs (Key Performance Indicators) da área, como OTIF (On-Time, In-Full), custo por km rodado, índice de avarias e produtividade da frota.
Propor e implementar projetos de melhoria contínua nos processos de expedição e transporte, buscando a redução de custos e o aumento da satisfação do cliente.
Requisitos
Qualificações
Graduação ou tecnologo completo em Logística, Administração, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas.
Sólida experiência (mínimo de 2 anos) em cargos de liderança e supervisão nas áreas de Expedição e Transportes.
São Diferenciais Para o Cargo
Experiência prévia no segmento de distribuição de materiais de construção, cargas volumosas ou pesadas;
Conhecimento intermediário em Excel e Power BI;
Conhecimento de WMS, TMS e da legislação de transporte rodoviário de cargas;
Habilidades Comportamentais
Forte capacidade de liderança, negociação e comunicação interpessoal. Visão estratégica e foco em resultados. Habilidade para trabalhar sob pressão e resolver problemas de forma ágil.

title: Scrum Master
description:
Working Hours: full overlap with EST (2PM - 11PM WAT)

Experience required: 4+ years of experience as a Scrum Master

We are looking for a Scrum Master to join our Legal PMO. We drive cross-functional alignment, create process efficiencies, and deliver large-scale strategic initiatives in a rapidly growing Legal Technology space, while supporting an exciting collection of B2C and B2B brands - Avvo, Martindale, Nolo, & NgageLive.

Scrum Masters (SM) are responsible for the day-to-day oversight of activities performed by a team while adhering to agile practices and disciplines. The SM would work very closely with agile teams to resolve team level impediments and manage risk. They are responsible for working closely with Product Owners to ensure that team members are working on the highest priority work items defined within the team's roadmap. The SM has a strong understanding of Agile Scrum and Kanban principles and practices. SMs are also responsible for providing hands-on support for the adoption of agile practices and identifying opportunity areas for improvement where it is warranted. Scrum Masters are strong communicators and are required to work closely with project managers & application teams to support the implementation of working software. Scrum Masters prepare deliverables and artifacts that highlight the progress accomplished by teams (velocity, sprint and feature burn-ups / burn-downs, cumulative flow reports, etc.) and are responsible for presenting those artifacts as needed.

Responsibilities:

  • Facilitates the execution and adoption of Scrum ceremonies (e.g., sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily standups, retrospectives, etc.) according to best practices
  • Manages the remediation of blockers and issues identified by team members to support the timely completion of sprint deliverables.
  • Works to remove impediments and manage dependencies.
  • Provides day-to-day coaching to team members to support the adoption of agile practices and disciplines.
  • Supports program planning activities as necessary in collaboration with partnering project/program managers.
  • Facilitates the definition and implementation of team-level working agreements to support the day-to-day delivery of working software.
  • Identifies and creates metrics (ex: burnups, cumulative flows, velocity charts) that measure and report on team performance, backlog health, and quality of delivered software.
  • Supports the implementation of improvement areas identified in team retrospectives.
  • Ensures the work implemented by teams adheres to the steps and procedures outlined within the definition of done (DoD) framework.
  • Acts as a servant leader for multiple teams and their stakeholders.

Required experience: 

  • 4+ years of experience as a Scrum Master in an Agile environment focused on software development
  • Bachelor's degree or higher.
  • Certified Scrum Professional (CSP)
  • Ability to identify and mitigate technical delivery risks.
  • Experience in managing more than one Scrum team.
  • Proficient in Google Workspace applications, including Sheets, Docs, Slides, and Gmail.
  • Familiarity with ticketing system (JIRA, YouTrack), wiki tools, and Git
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.

Bonus points for: 

  • Experience optimizing SDLC processes to improve the quantity and quality of work.
  • Ability to manage project delivery planning, estimating, and metrics reporting.

description:

Experiência em Área Industrial, de preferência em Siderurgia;
Disponibilidade para trabalhar em rodízio de turno.
Principais atividades:
Planejar a hora de segurança, abordando e discutindo o Sistema de Segurança e de Meio Ambiente, visando à orientação para a resolução de não conformidades e pendências, bem como, a conscientização profissional dos colaboradores para a eliminação de riscos ocupacionais;
Realizar inspeções nos locais de trabalho, identificando condições e ações inseguras, revisando análises preliminares de riscos e permissões de trabalho e registrando não conformidades, a fim de possibilitar o tratamento de falhas e viabilizar os meios necessários para minimizar riscos e evitar ocorrência de acidentes ocupacionais;
Participar de reuniões da CIPA, discutindo boas práticas, indicadores de controle e outros aspectos de segurança do trabalho, para a obtenção da interface necessária à adoção de soluções corretivas e preventivas com foco na eliminação de acidentes ocupacionais;
Participar de reuniões de alinhamento com os demais técnicos de segurança do trabalho, discutindo e avaliando situações de risco, a fim de possibilitar a definição de planos de ação e melhoria contínua do processo;
Elaborar e revisar padrões de segurança do trabalho, analisando, descrevendo, documentando e validando procedimentos junto ao Superior Imediato, a fim de possibilitar a uniformidade de critérios e estabilização de processos;
Atualizar relatórios de Segurança e Meio Ambiente;
Colaborar em projetos de modificações prediais ou novas instalações da Empresa, provendo suporte técnico de segurança do trabalho, para contribuir na definição de condições ocupacionais mais seguras;
Investigar e avaliar acidentes e incidentes de trabalho, analisando causas e níveis de gravidade, bem como, emitindo relatórios conclusivos, visando a adoção de medidas preventivas com foco na eliminação de reincidências;

Acompanhar atividades de manutenção in loco, fornecendo orientações sobre atos e condições abaixo do padrão, a fim de assegurar o cumprimento de procedimentos de segurança do trabalho.

title: TBM Instrumentation Technician
description:
Envie uma mensagem para o nosso WhatsApp no número e veja mais informações da vaga
Descrição das atividades que o profissional irá realizar
O Técnico em Instrumentação de Turbomáquinas será responsável por supervisionar e executar atividades de instalação, manutenção e solução de falhas em compressores centrífugos, turbinas e sistemas auxiliares relacionados.
O profissional deverá assegurar altos padrões de qualidade e segurança, possuir familiaridade com documentação técnica e demonstrar proficiência no uso de ferramentas eletrônicas para relatórios e registros. Atuará como ponto focal para todas as questões relacionadas a turbomáquinas e sistemas de controle.
Atividades
Supervisionar todas as atividades e operações de instalação de compressores centrífugos, turbinas e sistemas auxiliares, incluindo manutenções de grande porte e grandes paradas (overhaul).
Instalar, calibrar e monitorar sistemas de selagem por gás úmido (wet gas seal), em colaboração com as equipes de Instrumentação & Elétrica e supervisão de manutenção.
Monitorar diariamente todos os parâmetros das máquinas, identificando possíveis desvios, revisando alarmes e realizando diagnóstico e correção de falhas em casos de parada.
Supervisionar e solucionar falhas nos sistemas de vibração, incluindo sensores, proximeters, cabeamentos, cartões e sistema de monitoramento de vibração.
Executar e supervisionar atividades de manutenção e troubleshooting em diferentes tipos de compressores centrífugos e sistemas auxiliares de turbinas.
Preparar e verificar peças sobressalentes para instalação.
Realizar inspeções por boroscopia.
Conduzir e gerenciar Análises de Causa Raiz (RCA).
Prestar suporte à equipe de instrumentação offshore, quando necessário.
Manter elevados padrões de qualidade (QA/QC) e segurança (EHS) em todas as atividades.
Gerenciar Não Conformidades, Esclarecimentos Técnicos e Solicitações de Serviço.
Acompanhar atividades de preservação de materiais.
Utilizar e interpretar documentação técnica, incluindo layouts, diagramas P&ID (Tubulação e Instrumentação), especificações, desenhos técnicos e manuais.
Elaborar relatórios detalhados das atividades, utilizando ferramentas eletrônicas como M-files e SAP.
Responsável pela supervisão de Ordens de Trabalho no SAP, definição e otimização de planos de manutenção.
Requisitos
Formação técnica completa.
Experiência comprovada em instalação, manutenção e solução de falhas em compressores centrífugos e sistemas auxiliares, incluindo, entre outros:
THM1304, Turbine Solar T60, Turbine Nuovo Pignone PGT-5, Compressor Dresser-Rand, Compressor Nuovo Pignone BCL307, Compressor DEMAG 08MH/MV 7A.
Sólidos conhecimentos em sistemas mecânicos e técnicas de alinhamento.
Domínio do Pacote Office e SAP.
Fluência em português e inglês.
Competências Comportamentais:
Forte capacidade analítica e de resolução de problemas.
Atenção aos detalhes e pensamento analítico.
Boa comunicação, organização, relacionamento interpessoal e elaboração de relatórios.
Postura proativa, com capacidade de antecipar falhas potenciais.
Capacidade de manter o foco sob situações adversas.

  • Taxa de conversão de reservas.
  • Satisfação do cliente (NPS ou feedbacks de atendimento).

title: Gestor Comercial
description:
DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA


A Ademicon é a maior administradora independente de consórcios do Brasil. Com mais de 30 anos de história e presença nacional e internacional, somos referência em inovação, solidez e geração de valor para pessoas e empresas que buscam construir patrimônio de forma inteligente. Oferecemos consórcios de imóveis, veículos leves, pesados e serviços, com condições flexíveis e soluções financeiras pensadas para atender diferentes projetos de vida e expansão de negócios.

Com mais de 80 bilhões em créditos ativos e milhares de clientes contemplados, entregamos uma experiência completa: desde o planejamento da compra até a realização do sonho ou investimento. Acreditamos que democratizar o acesso ao crédito e impulsionar o desenvolvimento local são pilares para transformar a vida de famílias e fortalecer empresas. Nossos diferenciais: Especialistas em consórcios de alta performance Atendimento consultivo e personalizado Soluções sob medida para pessoas físicas e jurídicas Gestão transparente e sólida Mais de 130 mil clientes ativos Ampliação de patrimônio sem juros bancários.

Buscamos Gestor Comercial com visão empreendedora e habilidade de relacionamento com clientes diversos (PF e PJ) para atuar nas unidades da Ademicon da Barra da Tijuca, Américas (Recreio dos Bandeirantes) e Jacarepaguá.

O dia a dia envolve a gestão de equipes, atuação com vendas consultivas de produtos financeiros – Consórcio de Carro, Imóveis e Serviços - com foco na construção de relacionamentos sólidos e de longo prazo, assim como a atração e capacitação de novos consultores.

Nosso propósito é trazer impacto financeiro positivo para famílias e negócios.

Regime híbrido com flexibilidade.

Principais atividades:

  • Gestão e treinamento constante da equipe de Vendas;

  • Atração e capacitação de novos consultores de Vendas;

  • Acompanhamento e desenvolvimento de consultores na jornada de vendas e processos administrativos da gestão de carteira de clientes;

  • Prospecção ativa de clientes potenciais (PF e PJ), venda de serviços financeiros, gestão de carteira de clientes e pós venda;

  • Condução de reuniões com clientes potenciais englobando: identificação de necessidade, apresentação de soluções / produtos, simulação de cenários, negociação de propostas e fechamento de vendas;

  • Gestão do cliente no pós venda desde a gestão estratégica da carteira até os processos administrativos essenciais dos produtos adquiridos;

REQUISITOS DA VAGA

  • Sólida experiência com gestão de equipes de vendas;

  • Forte vivência na área comercial;

  • Experiência com vendas de produtos financeiros será um plus;

  • Alta ambição de carreira e visão empreendedora;

  • Boa comunicação e habilidade de relacionamento interpessoal;

  • Independência, autonomia com alto foco em resultados e performance;

  • Capacidade de trabalhar com metas e prazos de entrega de resultados.

BENEFÍCIOS DA VAGA

  • Contrato PJ 100% comissionado sem limite de ganhos;

  • Perspectiva de rendimentos acima da média do mercado;

  • Escritórios modernos e bem equipados para reuniões presenciais;

  • Plano de carreira estruturado com perspectiva de ascensão rápida;

  • Treinamento e capacitação técnica diferenciada com foco em alta performance.

Nossos Pilares:

PENSAMOS GRANDE: Nós nos desafiamos e sempre queremos ter mais da vida.

SOMOS EMPREENDEDORES: Fazemos o nosso sucesso, vestimos a camisa da empresa. Ademicon é nosso sobrenome.

MENTE ABERTA: Aceitamos mudanças e somos motivados por elas. Inovamos e fazemos de forma diferenciada.

title: Software Engineer Intern
description:
The Company

Katalyst Data Management (KDM) provides end-to-end subsurface data management solutions for the oil and gas industry. From data capture and verification to data storage and organization, to marketing data online, our specialized data services cater for small enterprises, through to large multinational and corporate data centers. KDM's web-based iGlass services and their related controls, including system redundancy, are key differentiators in providing and maintaining high availability, 24/7 access for customers. Innovation and commitment have enabled KDM to provide excellence in both technologies and service qualities.

  • Located in Barra da Tijuca, Brazil
  • 30 Hours Per Week - Monday - Friday

Key Responsibilities and Accountabilities

Build software that powers real‑world decisions. As a Software Development Intern, you'll contribute to production web applications across the stack—.NET Core and Python on the back end, React and jQuery on the front end—inside a collaborative culture that prizes innovation, performance, and scalability. Expect structured mentorship, meaningful ownership, and hands‑on experience with projects ranging from spatial data tools to specialized oil & gas solutions—think seismic and well data visualization/manipulation and web‑scraping pipelines—where advanced technology meets complex business challenges. If you're ready to learn fast, ship fast, and see your work make an impact, this is the opportunity.

Tasks:

  • Work with the development team to design, build, and maintain features across company applications using SQL, Java, .NET, Python, and JavaScript—leveraging frameworks such as React and jQuery.

Skills and Knowledge:

  • Analytical thinking – ability to break down problems into smaller components.
  • Understanding of algorithms – basic concepts like loops, conditionals, and data structures.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in Portuguese and English.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

This position has no supervisory responsibilities.

Position Type and Expected Hours of Work:

This is an internship position with a workload of 6 hours per day, totaling 30 hours per week.

Activities may be performed at Katalyst's office or remotely, depending on availability and team coordination.

The work schedule is flexible within regular business hours (Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m.), while respecting the 6-hour daily requirement.

Hybrid work model – three remote days and two on-site days per week.

Travel:

This position does not require travel. All work will be conducted in-office or virtually. If participation in an offsite meeting or company event is ever requested, Katalyst will cover or reimburse all related expenses in accordance with company policies and local regulations.

Required Education and Experience

Currently enrolled in a technology-related undergraduate program with at least one year remaining before graduation.

title: Retention Marketing Specialist
description:
UN/COMMON is a digital experience and marketing agency that launches and grows the world's best emerging brands. We believe the future of consumer-facing brands starts with creating authentic stories built for the consumer first and brand second. We are extremely proud to work with revolutionary brands such as Selena Gomez's Rare Beauty, Dermalogica, Liquid Death, Lemon Perfect, and more.

We are an employee and customer-centric agency bringing mission first brand stories to life to benefit the greater good and better people's lives. And we have a TON of fun doing it

The Retention Marketing Specialist owns the day-to-day execution of email and SMS production for our clients. This includes project management, content planning, copy and creative briefs, HTML builds, QA, and scheduling. You will manage end-to-end production and keep timelines on track across design, strategy, and client teams. You will work closely with a Retention Marketing Strategist to support retention strategy, reporting, and ongoing optimization. If you enjoy organized workflows, sharp deadlines, clean builds, and improving the customer journey through thoughtful messaging, you will do well here.

What You Will Do

You will manage the full production process for email campaigns and automated flows, build emails in Klaviyo or similar ESPs, write on-brand copy, create clear briefs for the design team, QA content and logic, and schedule deployments. You will maintain the monthly content calendar, drive timelines with clients, and ensure all assets and approvals stay on track. You will support the Retention Marketing Strategist by pulling performance data, analyzing results, and developing recommendations. You will build automated workflows, segmentation, and list logic, maintain list hygiene, and work confidently with Shopify apps such as Yotpo, Loyalty Lion, JustUno, and Privy.

Based on our projected customer base growth, we foresee the need for a  Retention Marketing Specialist  within the next 2-4 months to ensure we can effectively manage and nurture our expanding user community.

Requirements

What You Need

  • 2 years of experience in retention marketing, specifically across email, SMS, CRM, or loyalty programs.
  • Hands-on experience with an Email Service Platform (ESP), with a strong preference for Klaviyo.
  • Strong copywriting skills for direct-to-consumer (DTC) e-commerce, with the ability to adapt tone and style to match different client brands.
  • A solid understanding of email analytics and the ability to translate data insights into actionable strategy.
  • Clear understanding of the difference between marketing campaigns and automated flows, and knowing when to deploy each.
  • Proficiency in building segmented customer lists using behavioral and transactional data.
  • Experience working within Shopify or directly supporting Shopify-based clients.
  • A proactive, organized approach, with the ability to think through the entire customer journey and work effectively in a fast-paced, collaborative team.

What Success Looks Like

Your production process is smooth, predictable, and organized. Clients trust your communication and follow your timelines. Email and SMS performance improves because of your quality and attention to detail. Strategy and reporting move faster because you stay ahead of data and execution. You keep projects aligned, informed, and on schedule. You take ownership, ask smart questions, and keep work moving forward.

Benefits

This is a contract position
Up to 40 hours weekly
Remote

The selection process includes a video interview screening, followed by role-specific discussions (possible assessment) and a final leadership conversation.

UN/COMMON is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where all employees can thrive and bring their full selves to work.

About UN/COMMON

UN/COMMON has been recognized by Inc. Magazine as one of the fastest-growing private companies in America, reflecting our people-driven approach to growth, innovation, and excellence.

description:
ALLOS
é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a
Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls
, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

Whether you're looking to start your career or make a change, talk to us and see how you can elevate the power of your work at Iron Mountain.

title: Gerente de Planejamento Financeiro
description:
Gerente de Planejamento Financeiro (FP&A) deve ser responsável por estruturar orçamentos, prever cenários (forecasts), analisar variações de desempenho e apoiar decisões estratégicas com relatórios precisos.
Atuar no monitoramento de fluxo de caixa, controle de custos e alocação de recursos, sendo crucial para a saúde financeira e crescimento da empresa, geralmente exigindo sólida formação em finanças ou administração.
Principais Responsabilidades
Planejamento Orçamentário: Elaborar o planejamento orçamentário anual (Budget) e revisões periódicas (Forecast).
Análise de Variações: Analisar o orçado vs. realizado (Variação Orçamentária), identificando desvios e propondo planos de ação.
Gestão de Tesouraria/Fluxo de Caixa: Supervisionar contas a pagar/receber e o fluxo de caixa para garantir a liquidez.
Relatórios Estratégicos: Criar relatórios de performance (KPIs) para a alta administração, suportando a tomada de decisão.
Modelagem Financeira: Analisar cenários de investimentos, corte de gastos e melhoria do desempenho econômico. Formação:
Superior em Administração, Economia, Contabilidade ou Engenharia, com pós-graduação ou MBA na área financeira.
Habilidades: Forte capacidade analítica, visão estratégica, conhecimento em ERPs (ex: SAP, Oracle) e Excel avançado. +2Diferença entre Gerente Financeiro e de Planejamento: Enquanto o Gerente Financeiro foca mais na operação diária e tesouraria, o de Planejamento Financeiro (FP&A) foca na estratégia, orçamentos e visão de longo prazo.

Experiência com sistemas de medição de vazão, especificamente para distribuição de gás natural;

Seja por meio de orientação, treinamento ou oportunidades de liderança, investimos no seu sucesso para que você possa causar um impacto duradouro. Acreditamos que equipes diversas, trabalhando juntas, são fundamentais para impulsionar o crescimento e entregar resultados de negócios.
Reconhecemos a importância do bem-estar dos colaboradores. Oferecemos convênios médico, odontológico, farmácia e Wellhub (Gympass); seguro de vida; cooperativa de crédito; previdência privada; reconhecimento e muito mais. title: Analista BizDev Jr.
description:
Nuuvem, a leading company in digital game distribution in Latin America, is renowned for its profound passion for gaming and its strong market presence. We are looking for talented individuals to join our team of professional players, gaining valuable experience throughout the journey.

To support our growth, we are looking for a Junior BizDev Analyst to support the Publisher Relations team across day to day activities and ongoing initiatives. You will contribute to operational and analytical tasks, assist in recurring processes, and support the execution of projects related to partners, products, and commercial operations.

You will work closely with the BizDev team, collaborating with multiple stakeholders in a fast paced environment. If you are proactive, curious, and motivated to deepen your understanding of the gaming business, this is a great opportunity to level up with us.

This opportunity is valid for remote work. To excel in your work, wherever you choose to be, you'll need a broadband internet connection and your own computer.

  • Bachelor's degree in a related field such as International Relations, Digital Games, Communications, Marketing, Business Administration, or a similar discipline
  • Fluent English, with strong business communication skills
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and Google Workspace
  • Strong numerical and analytical skills, with the ability to work with spreadsheets and data

Nice to have
- Experience with CRM systems and pipeline management tools
- Proficiency in an additional language beyond English

What we value

  • A proactive and results oriented mindset, with strong ownership, curiosity, and the drive to understand the business beyond assigned tasks
  • Strong collaboration skills, with the ability to work as a true team player, actively seeking input, sharing context, and contributing to collective problem solving
  • Comfort working with numbers and navigating problem solving scenarios, including unfamiliar situations, with a hands on and solution oriented approach
  • Good prioritization skills, with the ability to assess scope, impact, and urgency of deliverables
  • Willingness to learn and adapt within in house developed systems and processes, linking day to day work to business value and outcomes

Important: Do not hesitate to apply if you don't have all the above knowledge or experiences Your ability to learn and evolve is more important than a checklist of previous knowledge and experiences

Main Responsibilities

  • Support the implementation of new sales strategies aimed at increasing revenue across the Nuuvem catalog.
  • Assist in the onboarding of new partners by addressing questions, aligning next steps, and ensuring a smooth operational handoff.
  • Organize and maintain the promotional and release calendar, collaborating in the execution of major commercial campaigns.
  • Review loss and margin related spreadsheets, and keep product and publisher information up to date within internal systems.
  • Manage new content entries and coordinate product launches with the Marketing team, ensuring the Release Tracker remains accurate and current.
  • Monitor and support existing partnerships by identifying improvement opportunities, tracking inventory levels, and resolving operational issues.
  • Ensure product availability on the Nuuvem Store by monitoring game key inventories and stock levels.
  • Track and update individual and departmental goals on a monthly basis.

Type of contract and Salary Range:


This position is under the CLT regime, with an approximate salary range of R$3.815,13 a R$4.198,75.

Benefits

  • Health and Dental Plan: Taking care of your health is no joke. Here, you get a top-tier AMIL plan with a symbolic R$ 1 payroll deduction.
  • iFood Benefits Card: Our meal allowance got an upgrade and it's way better now At Nuuvem, you get R$ 830 per month on the iFood Benefits Card (Elo network), accepted at millions of places across Brazil for both meals and groceries, in one tap on credit mode.
  • Monthly Stipend: Every little help counts Each month, we offer R$ 250 to support your home office setup or to help cover home expenses.
  • Personal Growth: We never want you to stop learning Every team member gets $70 USD per semester to invest in professional development—courses, books, events, you name it.
  • 4 Days Off 4 You: At Nuuvem, everyone gets 4 extra days off per year to take whenever they want…
  • Cart of the Month: What if we told you that every month you can choose as many items as you want from our store, up to a total of R$ 360? That's right. Free games, your way, with no red tape. Pick it, play it.
  • 20% Discount Coupons: Sharing is caring In addition to your free game, you also get 10 x 20% off coupons per year to use for yourself or gift to friends and family. Your game library will thank you
  • Wellhub (formerly Gympass): Sitting at your desk all day? Nope. We offer access to Wellhub, giving you entry to gyms, studios, therapy, nutrition, and online workouts. ‍ ‍
  • AVUS: Because your health matters With this benefits platform, you get 24/7 access to virtual medical support and a network of professionals across Brazil, ensuring personalized care anytime, anywhere. ‍
  • Starbem: Mental health matters too You get access to the Starbem app for medical, psychological, and nutrition consultations, plus pharmacy discounts—with no extra cost.
  • Stay: A calmer future starts now Our partnership helps you invest in your dreams in a simple, flexible way that fits your lifestyle.

Looking for Partners
Stock Options Program: Last but definitely not least: here at Nuuvem, you can become a shareholder After one year with us, you're eligible to be selected for our Stock Options Program—fully aligned with the benefits of our founders. No tricks here. We grow and win together

Other Cool Perks

  • Birthday Celebrations: Birthdays at Nuuvem are a big deal Each month, we host a virtual party with delivery credits, gifts, special activities, and of course, a lot of gaming.
  • Flexible Hours: Everyone's got their rhythm. We respect your routines and give teams the freedom to choose the working hours that fit their lifestyle—whether you're an early bird or a late starter.
  • Team Gatherings: We can't stay apart forever At least once a year, the whole team gets together in Rio de Janeiro for some much-needed in-person bonding and good times.
  • Relaxed, collaborative, and transparent environment: We keep it light, transparent, and co-op at heart. Everyone has access to everything they need, and we're always ready to support each other.
  • Gamer Team: Most of us are gamers (or soon to be) We live and breathe games and work hard to serve our community better. And if you don't game yet—no worries We welcome all, from veterans to future gamers.

title: Emergency Management Advisor
description:
This position requires full relocation to Saudi Arabia. It is a permanent full time Expat Relocation Package.
Job Overview
We are seeking an Emergency Management Advisor to Loss Prevention Organization (LP).
LP is responsible for providing both day-to-day in-field occupational and process safety support to Saudi Aramco operations, as well as centralized technical support and consulting function. Our field offices are located in Abqaiq, Riyadh, Ras Tanura, Dhahran, Udhailiyah, Jeddah (including Yanbu and Jazan), and Tanajib. Through these offices, LP provides its services to all Saudi Aramco facilities and departments that are located throughout the Kingdom.
Your primary role is to provide expert emergency management guidance to company organizations, help them develop and implement effective emergency management programs, and ensure compliance with industry best practices and recognized standards, including FEMA guidelines, NFPA 1600, and NFPA 1620.
Key Responsibilities
As the successful candidate you will be required to perform the following:
Provide strategic oversight of emergency management initiatives to ensure alignment with corporate emergency management objectives.
Conduct hazard identification and risk assessments to improve emergency preparedness.
Assist departments in identifying necessary resources to effectively respond to emergencies.
Enhance the performance of Emergency Control Centers (ECCs) to ensure coordinated and effective incident response.
Develop credible incident scenarios using an all-hazards approach based on assessed risks, supporting comprehensive emergency planning.
Develop pre-incident plans to support effective emergency response.
Develop site-specific emergency response plans tailored to diverse operational environments.
Design, deliver, and evaluate emergency management training programs for employees at all levels to build organizational readiness.
Plan, execute, and assess emergency exercises, integrating lessons learned into program improvements.
Develop emergency response strategies, facilitating the corporate emergency management taskforce, and enhancing the organization's overall business resilience.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams and senior leaders to ensure preparedness, response, and recovery frameworks align with operational goals and regulatory requirements.
Serve as a key facilitator for the corporate emergency management taskforce, ensuring cross-functional coordination and alignment with industry best practices.
Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure the effectiveness of emergency management programs.
Minimum Requirements
You will hold a Bachelor degree in Engineering, Engineering Technology, or safety from an Accredited Institution
You will have 7 years of experience as an emergency management advisor in the oil and gas, petrochemicals, or related industries, including as strong track record in delivering results. The experience should be comprehensive, covering the four phases of emergency management: mitigation, preparedness, response, and recovery.
You will have strong knowledge of FEMA guidelines, NFPA 1600, and NFPA 1620, and being certified as an emergency manager by the International Association of Emergency Managers is a plus.
You will have an excellent ability to communicate in English with peers as well as members of management, and be able to produce clear and concise oral and written reports in English.
Working Environment
Our high-performing employees are drawn by the challenging and rewarding professional, technical and industrial opportunities we offer, and are remunerated accordingly.
At Aramco, our people work on truly world-scale projects, supported by investment in capital and technology that is second to none. And because, as a global energy company, we are faced with addressing some of the world's biggest technical, logistical and environmental challenges, we invest heavily in talent development.
We have a proud history of educating and training our workforce over many decades. Employees at all levels are encouraged to improve their sector-specific knowledge and competencies through our workforce development programs – one of the largest in the world.
Aramco energizes the world economy.
Aramco occupies a special position in the global energy industry. We are one of the world's largest producers of hydrocarbon energy and chemicals, with among the lowest Upstream carbon intensities of any major producer.
With our significant investment in technology and infrastructure, we strive to maximize the value of the energy we produce for the world along with a commitment to enhance Aramco's value to society.
Headquartered in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and with offices around the world, we combine market discipline with a generations' spanning view of the future, born of our nine decades experience as responsible stewards of the Kingdom's vast hydrocarbon resources. This responsibility has driven us to deliver significant societal and economic benefits to not just the Kingdom, but also to a vast number of communities, economies, and countries that rely on the vital and reliable energy that we supply.
We are one of the most profitable companies in the world, as well as amongst the top five global companies by market capitalization.

description:
This position requires full relocation to Saudi Arabia. It is a permanent full time Expat position with an attractive relocation package. Please note only qualified candidates will be contacted.
***English proficiency (written and spoken) required***
Position Description:
We are seeking a Lead Corporate Data Officer to join our Corporate Data Office Division (CDOD) within our Cybersecurity Organization. CDOD focus on AI governance, including the design and implementation of robust AI governance frameworks that ensure the ethical, transparent, and compliant use of AI and machine learning technologies. Your primary role is to oversee the establishment and governance of key areas within the Corporate Data Strategy, approving the defined key performance indicators of data management and compliance. In addition, you will manage an enterprise-wide data governance framework.
Key Responsibilities:
As the successful candidate you will be required to perform the following:
Create and enforce policies for responsible AI development, deployment, and monitoring, ensuring alignment with global regulatory standards.
Design and implement comprehensive AI governance frameworks to ensure the ethical, transparent, and compliant use of AI/ML technologies.
Identify and appropriately manage AI risks through the organization's risk governance process.
Support the AI governance process, including management of the AI inventory, governance meetings, and management reporting.
Align AI governance strategies with organizational objectives, regulatory requirements, and industry standards.
Conduct AI risk assessments and develop risk mitigation strategies that align with the organization's risk appetite.
Monitor emerging regulatory trends and ensure proactive adaptation of governance policies to maintain compliance with evolving legal and ethical standards.
Develop and deliver awareness programs to educate stakeholders on AI governance principles, policies, and compliance requirements.
Provide insights and recommendations on governance-related challenges and opportunities.
Oversee periodic assessments of AI systems to validate adherence to governance standards and regulatory obligations.
Conduct impact assessments of AI systems, including the identification of potential biases, discrimination, and negative impacts on Saudi Aramco, individuals and society.
Establish AI evaluation and processes.
Research AI safety, fairness, bias, transparency, and explain ability.
Minimum Requirements:
You must hold a Bachelor degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field. A master's degree in Machine Learning, Data Science, or a related field is preferred.
You should have a minimum of 15 years experience in application development, system administration, and data management, including 10 years of experience of implementing AI , computer vision, NLP, and LLM solutions.
5 years of experience designing and implementing AI governance and risk management programs is also required.
You must be able to demonstrate strong knowledge in responsible AI and AI evaluations, bias detection, data centric, Agentic AI, AIOps , data privacy by design, LLM red teaming, methodologies for explain ability and interpretability and cloud computing environments.
You must be willing and able to relocate to Saudi Arabia on a full-time, permanent basis.
You must submit applications in English only.

title: Senior Director, Creative Strategy
description:
Role Overview
The Senior Director, Creative Strategy & IMX Stills, LATAM is a senior enterprise leadership role responsible for defining, shaping, and scaling end-to-end, consumer centric brand experiences for the Stills portfolio across Latin America. This role sets the experience ambition for the category—ensuring that brand strategy, creative excellence, media, and execution come together seamlessly across every consumer and shopper touchpoint.
Sitting at the intersection of Stills portfolio strategy, creativity, IMX, media, digital, and commercial agendas, this leader goes beyond campaign planning to architect long-term experience platforms and ecosystems that drive both cultural relevance and business growth for the Stills portfolio.
As a core leader within the IMX ecosystem, the Senior Director acts as a regional integrator and thought partner—aligning OU and global ambition with local market realities, and elevating how Stills brands show up in culture, commerce, and everyday consumption moments.
What You'll Do For Us
Integrated Experience Vision & Strategy (Stills)
Set and lead the LATAM end-to-end experience vision for the Stills portfolio, ensuring clarity, coherence, and scale across brands and markets.
Translate category and business challenges into bold experience platforms, grounded in human truths, consumer insights, and cultural relevance.
Design marketing and experience strategies across the full consumer and shopper journey, driving brand equity, conversion, frequency, and rituals for Stills brands.
Think systemically and long-term: build experience ecosystems and platforms, not one off ideas or executions.
Establish standards to ensure all plans deliver holistic, "no dead ends" experiences across owned, earned, shared, and paid touchpoints.
Creative Strategy, Stewardship & Excellence
Act as the senior creative and experience authority for the Stills category, connecting category strategy with creative development.
Own and evolve regional Stills portfolio narratives and experience frameworks, ensuring alignment with global brand intent and local cultural expression.
Shape fertile creative territories and guide integrated creative strategies across E2E, Design, Digital, Media, and Consumer & Shopper Engagement.
Set the bar for creative briefing, evaluation, and quality control, inspiring agencies to deliver breakthrough work.
Protect and elevate creative quality and brand integrity from ideation through scaled execution.
Champion digital first, experience innovation to keep Stills brands culturally relevant and future ready.
End-to-end Orchestration & Experience Delivery
Own the end-to-end experience agenda for the Stills portfolio, from strategic intent through market execution and learning.
Orchestrate complex ecosystems of internal teams and external partners (creative, media, production, platforms, creators).
Make enterprise level tradeoff decisions across ambition, timing, investment, and resources.
Ensure experience consistency across markets while enabling meaningful local relevance.
Translate Global Core Creative Ideas into contemporary LATAM executions that drive Brand Love (equity) and Brand Value (transactions, frequency, basket) for Stills portfolio.
Media, Data & Experience Effectiveness
Set expectations for media integrated experience strategies grounded in evolving consumption behaviors, media usage, and ecommerce dynamics.
Partner with Media, DAO, Analytics, and Performance teams to embed learning agendas and effectiveness frameworks into Stills experience plans.
Translate data, insights, and ROI signals into clear strategic direction for creative, media, and experience optimization.
Champion a performance mindset that balances long-term brand building with near term commercial impact.
Enterprise Leadership, Influence & Collaboration
Lead and inspire senior leaders and teams across functions, geographies, and disciplines.
Act as a regional connector for the Stills portfolio across:
OU E2E Experience Design
OU IMX and Stills portfolio Leadership
Franchise Marketing and Commercial Leads
Global IMX and Stills portfolio Leadership
Build strong, trust-based partnerships with bottlers and key commercial stakeholders.
Lead complex strategic conversations, influence senior executives, and navigate ambiguity with confidence and clarity.
Contribute to shaping the future of IMX and experience design through Stills category leadership and global collaboration.
Organizational Impact
Sets regional experience direction and standards for the Stills portfolio across LATAM.
Owns a critical enterprise discipline influencing Stills portfolio equity, growth, and cultural relevance.
Leads through senior leaders, enabling scale, consistency, and excellence across markets.
Plays a defining role in how Stills portfolio show up in consumers' lives—not just in communications, but in lived brand experiences.
Requirements & Qualifications
Bachelor's degree required, advanced degree a plus.
12+ years of experience across integrated marketing, creative strategy, IMX, media, or experience design.
Proven track record leading largescale, end-to-end experience strategies for brand portfolios.
Deep understanding of culture, entertainment, digital ecosystems, media, and commerce.
Strong background in consumer and shopper marketing; CPG experience required, beverage category experience preferred.
Extensive experience working with worldclass creative and media agencies.
Demonstrated success influencing senior leaders in complex, matrixed, multimarket organizations.
Exceptional storytelling, communication, and executive level influence skills.
English Required. Spanish Or Portuguese is required.
What We'll Do For You
Opportunity to shape iconic Stills portfolio across one of Coca Cola's most dynamic regions.
A leadership role with real creative and strategic influence, not just oversight.
Collaboration with top global and regional brands, creative, and media leaders.
Exposure to cutting edge experience design, platforms, and marketing technologies.
A chance to define how Stills portfolio evolve culturally and commercially for the next generation.
Skills
Influencing; organization; Creative Strategies; Brand Building

Annual Incentive reference value is a market-based competitive value for your role. It falls in the middle of the range for your role, indicating performance at target.
